newsitem.title: USA: Icing keeps barge traffic slow on Illinois River.
newsitem.headline: Icing keeps barge traffic slow on Illinois River.

text.p: Continued icy conditions on the Illinois River were impeding barge traffic Thursday, but warmer weather was seen easing navigation in the next few days, river dealers said.
"It's slowly getting a little better," said one dealer on the north central Illinois. "There's a couple of line boats that went through yesterday (Wednesday)."

Forecasts for the weekend showed temperatures as high as 40 to 50 degrees Fahrenheit in Illinois and other states bordering the river. The warmup was expected to break up the ice and improve the flow of barge traffic.
